evidence: Verified against a live Traccar 6.4 rig: a simulated device driven over the OsmAnd protocol produced positions that decode to schema-valid canonical events.
Traccar position id used as a vendor event id; every position in the rig run received a distinct identity.
Speed conversion from knots verified against values Traccar actually stored.
Device uniqueId (an IMEI in the rig) verified absent from every canonical event.

NOT forensics-ready: the pull reconciler is declared but untested, buffering and backfill behaviour has not been exercised, and timestamp behaviour has been checked only for the OsmAnd protocol rather than across the protocol range Traccar supports.
